description: This file contains an implementation of the RetrieveThingLiveCommand as an immutable class extending AbstractQueryLiveCommand, providing methods to create instances, set headers, and generate responses for live 'retrieve thing' commands within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: RetrieveThingLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of RetrieveThingLiveCommand, providing methods to create, modify headers, and produce answer builders for live 'retrieve thing' commands.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RetrieveThingLiveCommandImpl from a Command object, casting it to RetrieveThing.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets DittoHeaders on the command, rebuilding the underlying RetrieveThing command with selected fields.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides an answer builder for this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the class for debugging.
